extracted.name: Pecan Pralines
extracted.description: Pecans are cooked in a sugar syrup then dropped by spoonfuls onto baking sheets to set.
instruction_lines: Combine brown sugar, white sugar, water, and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a rapid boil; stir in pecans. Continue to cook and stir until large bubbles form on the surface, the pecans begin to look sugary, and a candy thermometer registers 240 degrees F (115 degrees C). Remove from heat and drop by rounded spoonfuls onto prepared baking sheets. Let cool completely.
